description.zh: 在这台电脑上运行 AI 模型，断网也能用：“翻译”选“本地模型”就能离线翻译，“按意思找”选“本地模型”就能离线按意思找文件，内容不出本机。可一键下载推荐的模型，也可以导入自己的 .gguf 模型文件（Ollama、LM Studio 下好的都行）。有显卡就用显卡，没有就用 CPU；不用时自动释放内存
description.en: Runs an AI model on this computer, with no network needed: set Translate's service to Local model to translate offline, or Search by meaning's to find files by meaning offline, and nothing leaves this PC. Download a recommended model in one click, or use a .gguf model file of your own (from Ollama or LM Studio too). The GPU when there is one, else the CPU; the memory is freed when idle

notes.zh: 新插件：在这台电脑上运行 AI 模型，断网也能用。在卡片上一键下载推荐的模型（Qwen3.5 2B，或只做翻译的 HY-MT1.5 1.8B；从 ModelScope 下载，可续传，下完核对 SHA-256），也可以选自己的 .gguf 文件。“翻译”和“按意思找”把服务选成“本地模型（离线）”就在本机完成，内容不出电脑；按意思找另需下载嵌入模型（Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B）。有显卡用显卡（Vulkan），没有用 CPU；5 分钟不用自动释放内存。需要 Win顺 0.49.0。权限：启动程序、联网（下载模型）、只在本机监听 TCP 39281、读取你选的模型文件。
notes.en: New plugin: runs an AI model on this computer, with no network needed. Download a recommended model on its card (Qwen3.5 2B, or the translation-only HY-MT1.5 1.8B; from ModelScope, resumable, SHA-256 checked) or pick a .gguf file of your own. Set the service of Translate or Search by meaning to Local model (offline) and the work is done on this PC; Search by meaning also needs the embedding model (Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B). The GPU when there is one (Vulkan), else the CPU; the memory is freed after 5 minutes unused. Needs WinShun 0.49.0. Permissions: starting programs, network (model downloads), listening on TCP 39281 for this computer only, reading the model files you choose.
